description: Join test coverage with hotspot risk. Returns files ranked by "risk × uncovered fraction" - the scariest untested files. Requires a coverage file at coverage/lcov.info, coverage/coverage-final.json, or coverage/coverage-summary.json.

limit.description: How many entries to return (default: 30, max: 200).

max_tokens.description: Cap the response size to roughly this many tokens (~4 chars/token). Truncates the entries array to fit.

package.description: Optional. Workspace package name (from projscan_workspaces) to scope results to one package only.

name: projscan_coverage
